purpose: Lifecycle status for every render pass / pipeline family so future slices MOVE a pass one step forward instead of re-deciding from scratch whether it should be modeled. Source of truth for scripts/check-pass-coverage.py.

status_legend.UNREGISTERED: ad-hoc GL state; no PipelineDesc row. next = register (or recon).
status_legend.DESCRIPTIVE_REGISTERED: PipelineDesc row exists + checked, but NOT applied via applyPipeline (state still hand-set).
status_legend.VISUAL_PROVEN: routed AND a before/after pixel-identical (or perceptual) gate passed.
status_legend.SPIRV_ELIGIBLE: visual-proven AND the shader family is baked + selectable as offline SPIR-V.
status_legend.DO_NOT_MODEL: intentionally never a static PipelineDesc row (dynamic-state emulator, non-draw, or not-a-pass). REQUIRES reason.

VFX.evidence: VFX-APPLYPIPELINE-ROUTING-1: routed at 3 live per-item blend sites — particle_billboard gos_particle_bridge.cpp:1127, tube_ribbon-deferred :767, vfx_mesh gos_vfx_mesh_bridge.cpp:311 — via applyPipeline(getPipelineDesc(blendMode?VfxXAdditive:VfxXAlpha)). State is byte-identical to the old hand-set glBlendFunc (recon §4: depth/cull/frontFace/offset never differ; the precise BlendMode rows + applyPipeline's switch + check-pipeline-key CANONICAL_BLEND guarantee the row->func mapping equals the old per-blendMode func). Build green; smoke PASS (multiple runs, no crash); no GL errors. glProgramName=0 so applyPipeline SKIPs program; drawBuffers/samplers/uniforms/VAO untouched.
VFX.proofNote: VISUAL_PROVEN NOT claimed. byte-hash is invalid (nondeterministic particle spawn) AND the runtime [PIPELINE_BIND] trace + visual A/B could not be landed in headless smoke this slice — the VFX/particle bridges only draw when effects actually spawn (combat), which idle tier1 smoke + the MC2_FX_FORCE_SPAWN fixture did not reliably produce in-frame, and the trace did not surface in the captured artifacts. Correctness rests on the state-equivalence argument (recon §4) + checker-guaranteed mapping, NOT on a runtime visual gate. Upgrade to VISUAL_PROVEN only when a real VFX-bearing A/B (oracle-coverage or eyes-on capture with confirmed in-frame particles) is obtained.
VFX.next: VFX-VISUAL-GATE-1: land a VFX-bearing capture (force in-frame particles, e.g. combat scenario / soak cheat / fixed-effect bookmark) + [PIPELINE_BIND] trace showing all 6 VfxX rows + oracle coverage A/B; then ROUTED_BY_APPLYPIPELINE -> VISUAL_PROVEN. This is the generic 'prove a nondeterministic visual pass' problem for future particles/spray/smoke.
